description: This file defines a Java interface named CommunicationLoggingListener, which includes a default no-operation implementation and a method for handling port holder messages.

classes.name: CommunicationLoggingListener
classes.description: An interface for listening to communication logging events, particularly port holder messages. Provides a default VOID instance with an empty implementation.

methods.name: onPortHolderMessage
methods.description: Method to be called when a port holder message is received. It takes the class type and message string as parameters.
